title: Pianist Labosche
summary: He praises a powerful pianist named Labosche who could break piano strings.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Now, speaking about piano players, you're never going to get a piano player like Labosche. You heard about him?

There's a piano player you should avoid. Oh, I'm done. He had a hand on that piano that when he was just mad and he played on that piano, he'd break the strings on it. No kidding. He was so sure of that piano. He would never play the piano like that. You should never see him playing like that. That's the way he was... Yeah, really.
I'm telling you, that piano would be taking a beat. Yeah, lift his hand way up from the keys every time.
